title: Native phone app (Android first, iOS later) that connects back to Genlock on the laptop: talk to the Assistant by dictation, get status updates, remote control
why: TJ: a native connection between genlock on the laptop and the phone, with dictation; not a 1-1 port of the Genlock UI, maybe just the Assistant

text: Pair a phone from the Mac app: a Pair phone button shows the QR and runs the bridge itself, so nobody runs node scripts (for other users)
